control.mac: SipHash-2-4(domain PTOB12C\x01 + body), per sender public fixture keys
control.admission: Complete authenticated record; participant role, boot/coordinator/challenge/config, monotonic sequence and original age. Public timing has no control admission. No counter wrap.
control.authority: Fixed TC-03 coordinator, independent candidate source, 60s source readiness and 3 advancing qualified reports in 6s; healthy incumbent retained.
control.handoff: PREPARE/READY after old fence; COMMIT/ACTIVE. STOP/STOPPED retires old decisions. Uncertain ACTIVE stops renewal until original permit+drain fence expires.
control.deadline: 3s maximum initial permit, 1Hz renewal. Conservative deadline conversion through known clock map, timer-rate and controller-drain bounds. Original deadline never restarted by reception/retry.
control.reboot: Fresh boot and authenticated challenge binding; coordinator waits at least max outstanding lease+drain after reboot. No passive election fallback.
control.scope_limit: Non-Byzantine provisioned peers; no arbitrary keyholder, unauthenticated reconnect, indefinite RF-loss availability or quorum guarantee.
control.cap_scope: Includes fixed coordinator; deterministic authorized slots. Overflow forced client. Each GM requires direct authenticated coordinator connection; no GM record forwarding over time relays.

precision.transport: Periodic Advertising without Responses (PADVB), LE1M,62.5ms; two500ms-spaced precision groups
precision.discovery: Recurring extended discovery advertising containing SyncInfo; separate 5ms model phase, 250ms model cadence
precision.modeled_AD_bytes: Root 118+20*n <=198; one-hop 118+24+20*n <=222. Actual production packing unresolved.
precision.reference: Exact unique captured physical original, scoped publisher/root boot/train/source epoch/event ID
precision.counter: PA event counter modulo16-bit alone is insufficient; bind unambiguous extended ID/train generation; repeated controller payloads cannot create new originals
precision.quality: UNKNOWN; independent precision null; PTS/WiFi OFF
precision.legacy_fixture: A/C use declared paired 31B original then correction20ms later, no claim to emulate V11 scheduler. Baseline native headers remain existing lab latest.

estimator_ready.status: Proposal minimum; physical uncertainty/qualification still required

evidence_limits: Source readiness is a declared model input, not GNSS qualification.
Clock map and controller stop bounds must be physically measured before exclusive service.
Virtual radio reservations include guards, discovery and empty ACL events; not observed RF/CPU/energy.
Synthetic causal output reports RMS/P99/max with bias retained; unavailable intervals and acquisition retained.
Production controller ABI, timestamp hooks, connection establishment/security, packet fragmentation, logging resources, absolute UTC and output qualification remain open.

one_hop.scope: root/root boot/source epoch plus relay boot/train/physical original
one_hop.parent_mode: Direct periodic root only; relay-of-relay rejected
one_hop.permission: Declared verified root extension token observed on direct root train; expires at original conservative root deadline. Renewal cannot restart received deadline. Actual public-verifiable token/precision encoding pending.
one_hop.causality: Root-derived affine projection at captured relay TX reference with mapping/residence error retained; far client correction after relay RX/work; no second-hop authority.
one_hop.extension_uncertainty: UNKNOWN physically; root plus mapping/residence/capture/output uncertainty must be accumulated
one_hop.precision_scope: Unqualified synthetic boundary time extension, not verified transparent-clock forwarding

quiet_client_profile.alignment: Client follows either run group; window anchored to advertised root run phase, with1ms lead. Same coordinated window for one-hop far clients.
quiet_client_profile.target: At least one corrected usable precision update per warmed second; count missed seconds separately from offered-packet coverage and held/fresh output.
quiet_client_profile.guards: No periodic RX outside chosen window; all RX guards must fit before quiet start.
quiet_client_profile.quality: Quiet held output synthetic only; PTS/WiFi remain OFF until total held error plus uncertainty <=500ns for actual blackout plus margins.
quiet_client_profile.relay_limit: Original500ms freshness and immutable permission enforced on TX and correction; local held output preserves age and UNKNOWN quality, expires1.5s after reference and creates no publication authority.
quiet_client_profile.GM_limit: Every GM and time relay stays online throughout each1s cycle. Only public clients may go quiet; full clients and GM followers observe both groups. No GM control over relay.
quiet_client_profile.maintenance: Last two slots also capture physical originals to keep always-online relay mapping fresh under loss, while carrying repeated correction history; half clients may skip them.

native_W12_lab_treatment.migration_budget: Separate measured profile, freeze before paired RF runs; no partition resizing
native_W12_lab_treatment.TC-02: Retain existing field image; excluded from lab writes and GM control

model_goals.nominal: Every warmed client second has a corrected usable reference; full clients and GM followers have one per complete500ms source window; causal full available output RMS<400ns and max<=1000ns including held cells
model_goals.loss10: At least99.9percent per predeclared treatment/path/mode reception denominator; actual missed seconds and missed windows retained
model_goals.faults: Safety and explicit refusal/unavailability, not uninterrupted precision
model_goals.physical_status: UNKNOWN; no native event association/quiet/output qualification from synthetic tests
